hook: The space under your bed is worth $30

scenes.visual_prompt: Camera drops low to floor level, showing dark dusty dead space under a bed frame
scenes.voiceover: This gap under your bed? That's free square footage you're not using.

scenes.visual_prompt: Someone dragging a heavy cardboard box out from under a bed, struggling
scenes.voiceover: And the reason nobody uses it is this — dragging a box out is annoying.

scenes.visual_prompt: Clear under-bed storage bin with wheels being pulled out one-handed, smooth and easy
scenes.voiceover: This 2-pack has wheels — 4.6 stars, 662 reviews — and you can pull it out one-handed.

scenes.visual_prompt: Side-by-side comparison graphic: eye-level shelf with clear bins vs under-bed bin with wheels
scenes.voiceover: Pair it with the clear shelf bins and you've covered both zones for under $60.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bin loaded with folded off-season clothes being rolled fully under the bed frame, disappearing
Final wide shot of tidy bedroom, no visible clutter, bed skirt down over the bin
scenes.on_screen_text: storage you forget is even there
scenes.voiceover: That's the goal — storage you actually keep using.

caption: The under-bed bin nobody buys because dragging boxes out is a pain — this one has wheels. 4.6 stars, 662 reviews, pairs with the $29.99 clear bin system in my last post. Full breakdown at the link.
